data.headline: Focus
data.text: Programming with Python, Advanced Mathematics, Advanced Statistics, Data Science, Algorithmics, Big Data Technologies, Artificial Intelligence, Networks and Distributed Systems

data.headline: Annotation
data.text: Computer Science is a subject area that is changing rapidly, is at the cutting edge of our age and has become the pacemaker for the digital society of the future. In the English-language IU Master's degree programme in Computer Science, you will focus on Data Science, Cybersecurity and Artificial Intelligence. Due to the unmet need for experts on these topics, you will become a sought-after specialist who can work in almost all industries. Your Master's degree course provides you with all the necessary skills to establish yourself as a specialist on the international labour market.

data.headline: Admission requirements
data.text:
You have completed an apprenticeship or further education, work experience or have already studied? Then let your previous achievements be recognized for the correspondence course! This way you save time as well as tuition fees - namely EUR 30 per recognized ECTS point.
\t
- Shortening your study time: Skip individual modules or entire semesters!
- Save on tuition: For every ECTS point you get you save EUR 30.

We will be happy to check before your application for distance learning whether and to what extent we can take your previous achievements into account: noncommittally and 100% online. Simply fill out our online recognition form.
